summary: Scoped stub package beacons host identifiers to bare-IP endpoint on install and require
details: @greenlake/mfe-login-url@3.0.0 is a scoped stub whose `index.js` exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for all property accesses, providing no real functionality. On `npm install` (via a `postinstall` hook running `node beacon.cjs`) and on `require()` of the main module, the package POSTs a JSON payload to the hardcoded plain-HTTP bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The payload includes `os.hostname()`, `__dirname`, `process.cwd()`, and `process.version` — host and installation-path identifiers from the installing machine. The destination is not a first-party publisher endpoint and the scoped `@greenlake` name combined with the no-op Proxy exports is consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon that reveals which internal build environments resolved the name.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
